items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Father St. Lawrence and Father Moron, they cut that out.

ctx.x: Well, the Catholic people used to have bands with them too? I see that's how I remember.

Well, yeah, Father St. Lawrence and Father Moron, they cut that out. Oh, I can't understand. It was terrible. The second line was so bad. And then it got so on the last, it had police, you know, to keep in with a funeral. That was terrible. Well, most of it was different people from what wasn't, you know, like, they had a few, maybe like the refined people and maybe that would be the family's request, you know. See, when Pa Rea died, plenty of people wanted to know, indeed. They didn't want no funeral. After they…
She had all those long parties.
